research_findings.bimodal_distribution: 38% of workflows always succeed, 21% always fail, 41% are mixed. The average hides this.
research_findings.do_not_constraints: Workflows with explicit DO NOT instructions are 61% more likely to be healthy (p=0.009).
research_findings.slash_command_broken: slash_command triggers have 0-17% success rate across all combos (e.g. 5% success across 111 runs, 14 workflows, 14 repos). Avoid until platform stabilizes.
research_findings.workflow_run_risky: workflow_run chaining has 3-12% success rate (e.g. issues+workflow_run: 12% across 130 runs, 15 workflows, 15 repos). Use pre-steps or schedule instead.
research_findings.pre_steps_help: Workflows with pre-steps are more likely to be active (+13pp internal, +5pp community).
research_findings.prompt_size_matters: Active workflows have 35-48% larger prompts. More detail = better outcomes.
research_findings.template_clones_fragile: 32% of workflows are template copies. Copied templates have lower success than customized ones.
